title: ‘Spider-Man’ continues to dominate box office, passing $2 billion globally
facts: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' grossed $70 million across North American theaters in its third weekend.
'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' reached a domestic box office total of $785.8 million, becoming the fourth-biggest domestic release ever.
'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' surpassed $2 billion in worldwide box office revenue.
'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' became the second-fastest film in history to cross $2 billion globally, doing so in 18 days.
'Avengers: Endgame' reached the $2 billion global box office milestone in 11 days in 2019.
Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' grossed $23.2 million domestically in its fifth weekend, reaching a domestic total of $504.7 million.
'The Odyssey' surpassed $1.2 billion at the global box office, including $36.6 million from its opening in China.
David Robert Mitchell directed the feature film 'The End of Oak Street'.
'The End of Oak Street' stars actors Ewan McGregor and Anne Hathaway.
'The End of Oak Street' earned $21 million domestically and $26 million internationally for a $47 million global opening.
The production budget for 'The End of Oak Street' was reportedly $80 million.
'Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie' earned $20.5 million across 3,545 North American theaters during its opening weekend.
'Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie' accumulated a global running box office total of $69 million.
Paul Dergarabedian serves as the head of marketplace trends for Rentrak.
Summer movie box office revenue in North America exceeded $4.2 billion.
